report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 76ms, zero dependency timeouts, INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR trace shows a 1907ms gateway->order call, which is insufficient to establish a root cause. No order/payment/inventory telemetry is available, so no bounded candidate can be substantiated. Handing off for downstream evidence.
